First public beta of **McScope**: a low-latency center-screen zoom lens for fullscreen games on Windows.

## Highlights

- Center-screen lens over borderless, windowed and most fullscreen games.
- **Gradual** zoom (eases to 1× at the edge, no seam) or **fixed** zoom (scope look).
- Live **radius** (0 – half screen height) and **strength** (1–10×) sliders.
- Bind a **keyboard key or mouse button** (right, middle, Mouse 4/5), with optional **hold mode**: the lens shows only while the bind is held.
- Updates every monitor refresh; the lens appears within a frame of pressing the bind.
- Never touches the game process: no injection, no hooks, no memory access.

## Install

1. Download `McScope-v0.1.0-win-x64.zip` below and extract it anywhere.
2. Run `McScope.exe`. The settings window opens on first launch; afterwards it lives in the tray.

Requires Windows 10 version 2004 or newer, or Windows 11.

> **Windows SmartScreen warning:** this beta is **not code-signed yet**, so Windows may show *"Windows protected your PC"*. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
>
> The exe was built from this repository's source by GitHub Actions. You can verify that before running it:
> ```powershell
> gh attestation verify McScope-v0.1.0-win-x64.zip -R tarekFerdous/McScope
> ```
> Or compare the SHA-256 in `McScope-v0.1.0-win-x64.zip.sha256`. Code signing via SignPath Foundation is in progress for future releases.

## Known limitations

- The lens runs about one monitor refresh behind the game; it can't be faster than the refresh rate.
- True exclusive-fullscreen games (mostly old DX9 titles) need borderless mode.
- The lens can't be screen-recorded (it is excluded from capture by design).
- Rotated (portrait) monitors aren't supported yet.

**Anti-cheat:** McScope stays outside the game, but no third-party tool can guarantee you won't be flagged, and a zoom aid may break some games' or leagues' rules. Use at your own risk.

Feedback and bug reports are very welcome. Please include `%APPDATA%\McScope\log.txt`.
